facts.fact: An Aadhaar number is a 12-digit random number
facts.quote: Aadhaar number is a 12 digit random number assigned to an individual seeking enrolment on completing the enrolment process.

facts.fact: It is assigned to a person on completing the enrolment process
facts.quote: Aadhaar number is a 12-digit random number assigned to an individual seeking enrolment on completing the enrolment process.

facts.fact: It is a digital identity that can be authenticated through biometrics or mobile OTP
facts.quote: This is digital identity issued to an Aadhaar holder which can be authenticated through biometric or mobile OTP.

summary: UIDAI 'Your Aadhaar' page still defines Aadhaar as a 12-digit random number assigned on completing enrolment, a digital identity authenticated by biometric or mobile OTP (top of page also adds face authentication).
